physicalEvidence.status: Verified current WPI own-group UR 10 learned-dynamics manipulation;2025 first hardware and 2026 revision separated
physicalEvidence.summary: ActivePusher combines neural residual dynamics with neural-tangent-kernel uncertainty to select informative pushes and bias an SST kinodynamic planner toward reliable actions. The full 2026 revision runs an actual six-DOF UR10 on cracker-box/mustard-bottle tasks, with FoundationPose and an end-effector RealSense D435 for object pose. Data collection uses an automatic pushing reset; the real planning experiment solves 20 randomly generated problems once, distinct from the larger simulation trials. It reports open-loop pushing and a separate replanning evaluation. Planar quasi-static motion, oriented-box approximations and sticking contact limit generality. The June 2025 first version already had physical pushing, but used LangSAM/template perception and one real learning object; do not treat the 2026 revision as first deployment or blend these implementations. Current lab roster identifies both lead authors as his PhD students.
